objective: Increase fresh public X status discovery yield without treating search rank as virality evidence.

author_watch.rotation_rule: Round-robin; avoid selecting exactly the same handles in consecutive runs when the pool permits.

topic_watch.rotation_rule: Rotate buckets across runs; retain one high-yield bucket from the previous non-zero run and replace the rest.

rules: Choose concrete named entities/events from the last 48 hours where possible.
Generate distinctive event keywords, product/person names and quoted short identifiers.
Search public indexes for real x.com/<handle>/status/<id> permalinks.
Upstream event popularity is not evidence that the X post is viral.

admission.high_distribution_hint: Prefer verifiable views >= 10000 or clearly abnormal public interaction counts; unknown metrics remain null.
required_for_recent_cohort: published_at evidence sufficient to classify freshness
admission.evergreen_rule: Older posts require durable novelty plus verifiable evidence and must be labeled EVERGREEN_REDISCOVERY.

anti_bias: Do not keep only winners; deliberately seek ordinary/low-distribution controls.
Do not infer virality from search-engine ranking.
Do not copy historical author metrics to new status URLs.
Do not repeatedly query only the same high-performing creators.
Do not reuse stale posts to make a zero-yield run look successful.
